definitions.explanation: Prefix used with certain nouns to ask 'what' or 'which' type of something.
Used with counters to ask about quantity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なん}{曜日|ようび}→何曜日：30346_nanyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}いましょう→会う：00482_au⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What day of the week shall we meet?

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なん}{人|にん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

examples.english: What time do you wake up?

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なん}{月|がつ}→何月：22086_nangatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|う}まれました→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What month were you born in?

examples.japanese: {何|なん}{語|ご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}しています→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{何|なん}{回|かい}→何回：08497_nankai⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many times did you go?

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なん}{個|こ}→何個：26687_nanko⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{何|なん}{歳|さい}→何歳：17594_nansai⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{何|なん}{本|ぽん}⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{何|なん}{番|ばん}→何番：09490_nanban⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

notes:
PRONUNCIATION: なん vs なに
- なん: Before た/だ/な row sounds and counters
- なに: Before other sounds, or standalone

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{何|なん}{時|じ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧ (what time)
- ⟦{何|なん}{曜日|ようび}→何曜日：30346_nanyoubi⟧ (what day of the week)
- ⟦{何|なん}{人|にん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧ (how many people)
- ⟦{何|なん}{個|こ}→何個：26687_nanko⟧ (how many items)
- ⟦{何|なん}{歳|さい}→何歳：17594_nansai⟧ (how old)
- ⟦{何|なん}{月|がつ}→何月：22086_nangatsu⟧ (what month)
- ⟦{何|なん}{日|にち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧ (what day of the month)
- ⟦{何|なん}{番|ばん}→何番：09490_nanban⟧ (what number)

ALSO:
- {何|なん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (why; by what means)
- {何|なん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (anything, whatever)
- {何|なん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (somehow, something or other)
